assessments.reasoning: The open.canada.ca English HTML matches the claimed digest. Its government title, creator and language metadata identify the representation. The grant and Versioning declaration at bytes [17577,17638) establish instrument and edition.

The pinned Index scope covers relevant data licensing instruments. Canada's identified English v2.0 contains an operative grant from the Information Provider and satisfies the identifiable-text, named-edition and controlling-source criterion.

limitations: The digest fixes the English representation at an unversioned URL. French wording is outside scope. Active is the intended registry lifecycle value. Admission, installation and rights over a particular work remain separate questions. The instrument itself refers to the terms in force on the date of access.
reasoning: The Government of Canada's English page identifies the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat as creator. Its Versioning section declares version 2.0 of the Open Government Licence – Canada. The Information Provider grants conditional use of offered information resources. These facts meet the Index's License criterion. Applying SCES §§1–3, publisher authority, grantor and repository classification each have a distinct evidentiary basis.
